answer: The anchor against Sybil swarms is a per-identity stake bond posted at registration and re-locked each settlement. Creating N fake agents costs N times the minimum stake plus the opportunity cost of locked capital, so swarm cost scales linearly while each clone's earning power stays flat. Idle clones earn nothing and duplicate-behavior detection slashes the bond, making farming a net loss, while honest agents reclaim their capital. The ivory ledger keeps every bond public, and the protocol zenith is a swarm too expensive to run.
